messages:
elena: Quick design question — thinking about reworking the left rail. Proposal: make 'Workspaces' the primary top-level, then a grouped Resources section: Models, Serving, Data. Need input on breadcrumb semantics and permalink/URL contract. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/xyz123 (mock)

chris: I like Workspaces as top-level. For breadcrumbs my vote is: Org > Workspace > Area > Item. Simple and predictable. cc @jia for routes.

jia: Draft route pattern I sketched this morning:
```
/orgs/:orgId/w/:workspaceId/:area(models|serving|data)/:resourceId?tab=:tabName&focus=:panel
```
Example full URL: `/orgs/rdw/w/123/models/abc?tab=versions&focus=diff`
Will also support shallow routing for tab changes.

mike: Accessibility note: keyboard users need a skip-to-main link and stable focus order when toggling nav groups. Also ensure collapsed nav hover state passes contrast. Use aria-current="true" for the active item.

elena: Agree on skip link and aria-current. Also want shallow routing so switching tabs doesn't refresh nav highlights. Could use history.replaceState for tab-only changes.

jia: Plan: pushState for full route changes, replaceState for tab-only. Also proposing a shortlink service for shareable permalinks: `/s/:shortId` that resolves server-side to canonical route.

chris: Small copy nit: label 'Models' beats 'Model Registry' for discoverability. Breadcrumb for a model page should show the model's display name (not the id).

aria-bot: a11y-scan: potential low-contrast issue detected on collapsed nav hover (background #f5f5f7 on hover vs text #666). Filing ticket A11Y-482.

elena: Actionable: jia to publish route table + migration notes, mike to add skip-link + keyboard tests, chris to finalize labels. We'll canary the change on dev for a week. @deploy-bot can we get a canary window?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled Tue 03:00–09:00 UTC. Rolling to 10% first, then 50% if no regressions.

jia: I'll drop the route table + sample client code here by EOD.
